x: He was also a keen boxer, and was advised by a colleague (Fre[illegible] Stone - now a Belgrave Vice-President) to join Belgrave Harriers and train with the road walkers to develop strength and stamina.
Walker went off first for us and he beat Stone of Dorking and Martin of Walton AC to give Jack Braggington a useful lead, and his time of 14:12 beat the previous course record.
Belgrave B (D.Anderson 13:44, R.Harding 14:22, A.Stone 14:40, L.Coy 16:18, M.Lewington 13:51 and 15:14).
Belgrave were 2nd in the Surrey Champs. both in the team and individual, Len Herbert following Stone of Dorking St. Pauls and with only two in the first ten.
